en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 7, 2026
en.summary: The Equal Rights Center secured an agreement for accessibility upgrades at a D.C. apartment building, while the EU’s updated Disability Rights Strategy drew criticism for lacking ambition. Model Tasha Ghouri launched an accessible fashion brand, and a university announced a new digital accessibility policy to improve online access for students with disabilities.

highlights.title: Equal Rights Center Reaches Agreement to Ensure Accessibility for People with Disabilities at D.C. Apartment Building - Morningstar
Update of EU Disability Rights Strategy lacks ambition to advance our rights
Tasha Ghouri launches 'accessible' fashion brand and webstore
University adopts policy on digital accessibility
